intro.text: Leopard Energy (f/k/a Cyber Apps World Inc.) was incorporated on July 15, 2002, under the laws of the State of Nevada and engaged in a number of businesses until April 9, 2015, at which we merged with our wholly owned subsidiary Cyber Apps World Inc. and concurrently changed our name to Cyber Apps World Inc. At the time of the merger, we shifted our business focused to the development of mobile applications focusing on allowing users around the world to save money on products and services from member merchants and suppliers instantly with mobile coupons, using their desktops and/or mobile devices, including smartphones.
